blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all five V195 main views and six pose renders shows the overskirt broken into dense, sharp triangular folds across neutral, standing poses, crouch, sit, prone, and side/back views. The cloth no longer reads as a sewn pleated garment and fails appearance and customer usability.

The V195 Blender cloth report records native selfCollision=true with selfCollisionDistanceMinM=0.015 m. Its fixed source-polygon fan audit reports 7,447 inverted skirt triangles across 20,701 skirt source triangles; lap-panel maximum vertex displacement is 0.1222 m left and 0.1258 m right. These are prototype instability measurements, not acceptance.

Direct crouch and sit renders still expose substantial anterior thighs and leave the seated lap inadequately covered; the tested native self-collision setting did not yield an acceptable motion silhouette.
The jacket still has visibly angular planar surface artifacts and an unfinished waist transition in the direct V195 views.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
